About.label: 01 — About
About.headline: I build software end to end — from the first architecture decision to the last deploy.

bio.one: My work sits between engineering and product: designing systems, shaping interfaces and keeping infrastructure honest. I care about software that stays legible years after it ships — clear boundaries, small surfaces, decisions that can be explained.
bio.two: I use AI as part of the engineering process: to explore options faster, test assumptions and raise the quality of what goes out — never to skip the thinking.
